title: Binary debit machine
statement: There is a finite Turing machine with one work tape, Boolean tape symbols, and states consisting of either an optional Boolean or a Boolean. It starts in the state containing no pending Boolean; in that state, a scanned false is replaced by true while the head moves right, a scanned true is replaced by false while the head moves left and records true as pending, and a blank is left unchanged while the head moves left and records false as pending. With a pending Boolean, a scanned symbol is left unchanged while the head moves left; at a blank, the head moves right and the machine enters the state carrying that Boolean. In a state carrying a Boolean in the second component, the transition is the specified control action.
hypotheses_covered: State set is the disjoint union of optional Booleans and Booleans
caveat: The final transition refers to a control action whose definition is not included in the supplied statement, so its behavior cannot be specified more fully.
